name: EMBO Postdoctoral Fellowship
amount: Salary (EMBC member states) or stipend (elsewhere), relocation allowance, child allowance; access to Laboratory Leadership course
other_rules: Doctorate within 2 years of the application date (or held by fellowship start)
at least one first-author paper accepted or published (or a first-author preprint with public independent peer review)
must move between countries: cannot go to the country of the PhD or a lab where you spent over 6 months
cannot join the PhD lab or work with the PhD supervisor
if already in the host lab, under 6 months there
project must not directly continue the PhD work
one application per round and only one reapplication
one of the PhD institution or host lab must be in an EMBC member state or cooperation partner (India is a partner)
notes: Last confirmed deadline 10 Jul 2026, 14:00 CEST; EMBO runs regular rounds, so check the next cutoff on embo.org. Fellowships last up to 2 years. Life sciences only.
